summary: Rail Vision Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, attaching a press release announcing a non-binding memorandum of understanding (MOU) with Railserve Inc., a Marmon Rail company, to expand their existing collaboration. The MOU is exploratory and concerns potential additional deployments of Rail Vision's ShuntingYard perception systems, new use cases, and broader rail yard solutions. No financial terms, stake, price, premium, or binding obligations are stated. The expanded collaboration is subject to a future binding agreement. This is a routine business development announcement, not a special-situation event. No deal terms are present.
